dedupe_keys.name: cefio chinese electricity focused input output tables 2018

description: The CEFIO research team publishes electricity-focused input-output tables for China's 2018 economy. The collection separates 14 electricity subsectors, including detailed coal and alternative generation categories. It supplies a 166-sector table and an aggregated 55-sector version, a binary bridge matrix, bilingual sector classifications, input data and discrepancy checks. Values use 2018 producer prices in units of ten thousand CNY. Excel and MATLAB data files, with four MATLAB construction and balancing routines, are free under CC BY 4.0. The tables can support electricity-transition and supply-chain simulations, with data-exiobase offering a distinct international input-output context. A caveat is that sector disaggregation and manual adjustments are modelling choices, not independently observed flows for every entry. The archive includes both inputs and derived results, which should not be double counted. The collection API failed, but its browser page and all seven component metadata pages were verified without downloading tables.
